top_news.title: Graph-Based Phonetic Error Correction of Noisy ASR
top_news.dek: Researchers propose a graph-based correction method to fix phonetic errors in ASR systems that often plague critical tokens like named entities.
top_news.brief: ASR systems frequently misidentify semantically important words due to phonetic similarities. This new approach moves beyond token-level correction by using a structured graph to address these systematic errors, improving accuracy for critical data points.

top_news.title: Scaling AI Inference Across Multiple GPUs Using NVIDIA TensorRT with Multi-Device Inference Support
top_news.dek: TensorRT 11.0 introduces native multi-device inference support to scale generative AI workloads across multiple GPUs.
top_news.brief: NVIDIA's latest TensorRT update enables high-performance inference across multiple GPUs. It maintains critical optimizations like kernel fusion and quantization, allowing developers to scale production pipelines that exceed the memory or compute capacity of a single device.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing multi-GPU inference scaling in TensorRT

top_news.title: Which tokens does a hybrid model predict better?
top_news.dek: Hybrid language models outperform standard transformers on context-dependent tokens, while transformers excel at verbatim copying.
top_news.brief: A comparative analysis between Olmo 3 and Olmo Hybrid reveals distinct architectural strengths. Hybrid models demonstrate superior predictive performance for meaning-bearing, context-heavy tokens, whereas transformer-based models retain a performance advantage for verbatim text reproduction.
top_news.image_alt: Comparison chart of token prediction accuracy between hybrid and transformer models

primary.summary: Baidu open-sourced Unlimited OCR, a 3B-parameter MoE model that parses dozens of document pages in a single forward pass.
